d.ko: So.... got what it takes to be a X Slayer?!?... 7 weapons, blood and gore, twisted music by Seepage & Psyko Syndikate, and maps where you can blow up everything. its awesome. started making it in 1998 in high school with my friend and now im 37, so i have life experience now.
d.en: So.... got what it takes to be a X Slayer?!?... 7 weapons, blood and gore, twisted music by Seepage & Psyko Syndikate, and maps where you can blow up everything. its awesome. started making it in 1998 in high school with my friend and now im 37, so i have life experience now.
d.zh: 所以……X杀手要有哪些东西？！？……要有7件武器，要有血腥暴力，要有滴水疯子辛迪加扭曲的音乐，还要有所有东西都能破坏的场景地图。这游戏感觉特别爽，我98年还在上高中，就开始跟朋友一起开发，现在37了，人生阅历丰富了很多。

rv.t: ※본 게임은 Hypnospace Outlaw의 외전이며 본편을 먼저 플레이 하신다면 더 재밌게 플레이 하실 수 있습니다! 1999년 우리가 기억하는 그 철없는 14살 관종 꼬맹이가 성장해서 36살 철없는 애딸린 어른이 되어 돌아왔습니다! …
